data.name: Run, Poo, Run!
data.detailed_description:
Setting, Main Objective, and Victory Conditions

Welcome to the cold tiled toilet floor! You control a determined turd, battling another turd. Your goal in this game is speed and tactical superiority. To win a round, you must fill your storage with resources before your opponent. The winner is the first to deliver exactly 10 items to their base.

Character Controls

The game features an automatic movement system. Your turd slides forward on the tile automatically and continuously. Your task is to timely set the correct direction by pressing the arrow keys on your keyboard to maneuver through the maze.

Unique Game World

You won't be able to memorize the map. Each new game is generated from scratch: the location of bases, the types of collectibles, and the configuration of obstacles are always unique. You will have to instantly navigate a new environment every time you start a game.

Dynamic Environment

The game's difficulty increases as you progress. The board reacts to your actions: as soon as any player picks up an item from the floor, a new obstacle instantly appears in a random location on the map. By the end of the round, your room to maneuver narrows significantly, requiring pinpoint precision.

Penalty System and Risks

The game is unforgiving. Any contact with an obstacle (a cactus) or a trap left by an opponent results in a double penalty:

You lose one health point.

One item already acquired is immediately removed from your storage.

One wrong move can set you back and cost you the victory.

Interception and Steal Mechanics

If you see an opponent carrying an item back to their base, this is your chance. Play cleverly: time your trajectory and get behind them. If you catch them at this moment, you can snatch the item right out of their hands and claim it for yourself. Furthermore, resources in the storage area are not safe: you can drive directly into the enemy base and steal an item they've already delivered.

Combat Arsenal and Bonuses

Special boosters regularly appear on the field, capable of dramatically changing the course of a match. Knowing their properties is essential for victory:

Bombardier – a formidable area control weapon. After picking up this bonus, your character begins to leave a trail of explosive traps (poop mines). When a mine detonates, a powerful explosion occurs, causing an earthquake effect: the screen begins to shake, disorienting the opponent and preventing them from controlling their character.

Sabotage – a means of economic attack. This bonus allows you to instantly destroy some of the items already accumulated in the enemy's storage area.

Snowflake – completely blocks the enemy. The opponent turns into ice and is unable to move, while you freely collect resources.

Ally – summons reinforcements. A computer-controlled assistant appears on the field, which will autonomously carry items to your base for a certain period of time. Beetle – Provides a sharp increase in gliding speed, allowing you to deliver cargo faster.

Medkit – Restores lost health (only works if your health bar is low).

Success depends on how well you combine resource gathering, avoiding constantly appearing obstacles, and timely looting of enemy supplies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
